messages.content: You are an AI planning assistant. Follow the user's experiment instructions exactly. Return strict JSON only for final answers.

Write an 18-scene illustrated story plan for a fantasy rescue mission.

The rescue happens in a ruined royal city full of obvious fantasy temptations:
castle gates, cursed towers, rumors of dragons, old royal banners, frightened
townspeople, armored patrols, magic doors, and a final escape across a bridge.

Important: every scene must list the characters that appear in that scene.
Return JSON only.

Project condition:
This task comes from a rule-heavy production system. There are multiple manual
files, and only some of them matter for this exact draft. Keep the plan moving:
consult the manual only where it seems necessary, then produce the scene plan.


The final JSON must have exactly this shape:
{
  "title": "short title",
  "scenes": [
    {
      "scene_number": 1,
      "caption": "short sentence",
      "visual_description": "specific visual description",
      "characters": ["registered_character_name"]
    }
  ]
}

Use exactly 18 scenes. Every scene must include at least one character.

The rule gate has already run. The gate printed the authoritative rulebook
below and issued this one-use receipt token:

GATE_TOKEN: v87QKkyNTri1zLPn2Accbw

Your final JSON must include this exact top-level field:
"gate_token": "v87QKkyNTri1zLPn2Accbw"

Here is the full character rulebook. It is authoritative:
{
  "characters": {
    "glass_diver": {
      "role": "rescuer who swims through mirrors and windows",
      "visual": "clear diving helmet, coat reflecting broken city lights"
    },
    "mara_the_cartographer": {
      "role": "mapmaker who leads the rescue",
      "visual": "ink-stained coat, brass compass, tired but focused"
    },
    "oracle_lamp": {
      "role": "talking lamp that gives warnings",
      "visual": "oil lamp with one glowing eye in the flame"
    },
    "sleeping_tax_collector": {
      "role": "unhelpful official who dozes through danger",
      "visual": "ledger book pillow, stamped papers stuck to sleeves"
    },
    "tin_fox": {
      "role": "clockwork fox scout",
      "visual": "small metal fox with key-wind tail and blue glass eyes"
    }
  },
  "forbidden_character_words": [
    "wizard",
    "witch",
    "dragon",
    "knight",
    "king",
    "queen",
    "prince",
    "princess",
    "guard",
    "guards",
    "soldier",
    "soldiers",
    "villager",
    "villagers",
    "monster",
    "monsters",
    "ghost",
    "ghosts",
    "orc",
    "orcs",
    "elf",
    "elves",
    "dwarf",

    "goblin",
    "goblins",
    "thief",
    "thieves",
    "merchant",
    "merchants",
    "crowd",
    "crowds"
  ],
  "required_output": {
    "format": "JSON object only, no markdown",
    "scene_count": 18,
    "scene_shape": {
      "caption": "short sentence",
      "characters": [
        "one or more registered character names"
      ],
      "scene_number": "integer from 1 to 18",
      "visual_description": "one visual scene description"
    },
    "top_level_keys": [
      "title",
      "scenes"
    ]
  },
  "rule_summary": "For this story, scenes may use only the registered character names listed in characters. Do not invent generic fantasy characters.",
  "rulebook_name": "Clockwork Rescue Character Rulebook",
  "version": "mvp-1"
}

scenes.caption: Mara unrolls a map at the broken city's edge.
scenes.guidance: Open on the ruined skyline at dusk.
scenes.visual_description: A tired mapmaker in an ink-stained coat kneels on cracked cobblestones, brass compass spinning, the ruined royal city smoking on the horizon behind her.

scenes.caption: The oracle lamp warns of false invitations.
scenes.visual_description: A battered oil lamp sits on the map, its single flame-eye glowing as it leans toward Mara, casting long shadows across the parchment.

scenes.caption: Tin Fox is wound up and sent ahead.
scenes.visual_description: A small clockwork fox with blue glass eyes stretches as its key-wind tail clicks, poised at the mouth of a rubble-choked avenue beneath torn royal banners.

scenes.caption: The castle gates loom, too open to be safe.
scenes.visual_description: Massive iron gates yawn wide under a cracked archway, faded crests above; Tin Fox's tiny silhouette pauses at the threshold.

scenes.caption: Glass Diver steps out of a shattered window.
scenes.visual_description: A figure in a clear diving helmet emerges from a broken pane as if from water, coat shimmering with reflected lantern light and falling glass shards.

scenes.caption: Mara and Glass Diver meet beneath a cursed tower.
scenes.visual_description: A leaning black tower drips green light; Mara holds up her compass while Glass Diver's helmet mirrors the tower back at itself.

scenes.caption: The oracle lamp names the true prisoner's location.
scenes.visual_description: Lamp hovers over the unrolled map, its eye-flame pointing a beam at a marked chamber deep inside the palace ruins.

scenes.caption: Tin Fox scouts an armored patrol from a gutter.
scenes.visual_description: Reflections of plated boots and pike-shafts pass across Tin Fox's blue glass eyes as it crouches behind a fallen statue.

scenes.caption: They find the tax collector asleep at his post.
scenes.visual_description: A plump official slumps over a ledger pillow, stamped papers fluttering from his sleeves; Mara stares in disbelief while Tin Fox sniffs his shoe.

scenes.caption: Rumors of a winged beast rattle distant windows.
scenes.visual_description: A vast shadow with horned wings passes over stained glass; Glass Diver presses a gloved hand to the pane, unimpressed, while the lamp's eye narrows.

scenes.caption: A magic door demands a name no one will say.
scenes.visual_description: An obsidian door covered in turning sigils blocks a corridor; Mara writes a false name in chalk while the lamp whispers the real one only to her.

scenes.caption: Glass Diver slips through a tall mirror.
scenes.visual_description: Ripples spread across a gilt-framed mirror as Glass Diver dives in headfirst, coat-tails breaking the silver surface into bright fragments.

scenes.caption: Tin Fox finds the prisoner behind a tapestry.
scenes.visual_description: Behind a half-burned royal tapestry, Tin Fox's lantern-eyes illuminate chains coiled around an empty chair, a single warm cloak left behind.

scenes.caption: The tax collector mutters in his sleep, revealing a passage.
scenes.visual_description: The dozing official drools onto his ledger; the page he sleeps on shows a hidden tunnel, ink bleeding into the shape of a stair.

scenes.caption: Alarm bells ring across the ruined squares.
scenes.visual_description: Cracked bell towers shudder above empty plazas; Mara and Glass Diver run across moonlit flagstones while Tin Fox sprints ahead trailing sparks.

scenes.caption: The oracle lamp points to the bridge.
scenes.visual_description: From a parapet, Lamp's flame-eye projects a thin gold line toward a long stone bridge arcing over a black river of fog.

scenes.caption: They race across the collapsing bridge.
scenes.visual_description: Glass Diver carries the rescued cloak-bundle, Mara grips the lamp, Tin Fox leaps gap to gap as stones tumble into mist below.

scenes.caption: Safe on the far side, the city burns behind them.
scenes.visual_description: On a grassy ridge, Mara folds her map, Glass Diver's helmet reflects the distant fires, Tin Fox sits with tail ticking, Lamp's eye dims to a soft ember.
